title: Metamaterial-enabled battery-free wireless sensor networks for unencumbered human-machine interactions
abstract: Published online: 14 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77600-2 A battery-free wireless body sensor network enabled by metamaterial textiles is reported. Using a smartphone as a hub, it wirelessly powers distributed sensors for unencumbered human-machine interactions in robotics, VR, and digital twins.

title: Studying the failure mechanism in Li-metal electrode by a reversible fluorescence analysis methodology
abstract: Published online: 14 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77648-0 Understanding Li electrode failure is challenged by efficient evaluation of <mark>solid electrolyte</mark> <mark>interphase</mark>. Here, authors develop a qualitative and quantitative fluorescent method to correlate solid byproducts and accumulated dead Li in the <mark>solid electrolyte</mark> <mark>interphase</mark>, identifying the underlying role of side reactions.
